longDescription: Understanding Digital Communication Platforms. Analysing Key Classifications of Digital Communication Platforms. Identifying Types of Digital Communication Platforms. Participants will explore the capabilities of various digital platforms, enabling them to make informed decisions in the dynamic landscape of digital marketing and communication.
